g.text: $ cargo xtask run
[INFO] hello from the kernel
[INFO] gdt: loaded GDT, TSS, and segment registers
[INFO] idt: installed interrupt descriptor table
[INFO] cpu: AuthenticAMD "QEMU Virtual CPU version 2.5+"
[INFO] cpu features: nx=true sse2=true smep=true smap=true x2apic=false xsave=false pcid=false
1gib=false rdrand=false invtsc=false syscall=true
[INFO] cpu protections: smep=true smap=true
[INFO] memory: 205 MiB usable / 251 MiB total across 36 regions
[INFO] layout: hhdm=0xffff800000000000 kernel phys=0xbba1000 virt=0xffffffff88a3a000
[INFO] kaslr: kernel slide=0x8a3a000 (subtract from addrs before addr2line)
[INFO] frames: 205 MiB usable, 52580 free / 57442 total frames tracked
[INFO] frames: alloc/free smoke test passed
[INFO] paging: running on our own PML4 (higher half inherited)
[INFO] paging: map/translate/unmap self-test passed
[INFO] harden: NX on; protected 73 kernel pages (0 huge skipped)
[INFO] harden: verified — .text R-X, .rodata/.data NX, HHDM NX, no W+X
[INFO] guard: unmapped 4 stack guard pages
[INFO] heap: ok — Vec/Box verified; 1288 KiB mapped, 0 bytes live
[INFO] pf: probe verified — guard page faults & recovers, mapped memory reads ok
[INFO] untyped: retyped 8x256B at 0x1aa000; 2048 B used, 2048 B free of 4096
[INFO] untyped: over-budget retype correctly rejected; accounting intact
[INFO] caps: CNode cap space (16 slots) holds endpoint+notification; SEND-only copy attenuated &
verified
[INFO] invoke: retype->frame, identify, rights-denied, and signal all behaved correctly
[INFO] sched: cooperative round-robin across the boot thread + 2 kernel threads
[INFO] sched: both threads ran via context switch (A=3, B=3)
[INFO] syscall: entering ring 3 (user stub syscalls in and out)
[INFO] syscall: ring-3 call — cap=7 label=42 len=1 mr0=0xc0ffee
[INFO] syscall: ring-3 exit — returning to the boot thread
[INFO] syscall: back in the boot thread after ring-3 round trip
